notablePrerequisites: You have at least one creature card in hand and your graveyard.
description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {1} and discarding a creature card from your hand, targeting any other creature card in your graveyard.
Telekinetic Bonds triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning a creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have a large amount of mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw cards.
